purpose: held-out exemption check: written after round 1, not used to tune the wording
mechanism: The change adds an account prefix to the event key of the payment ledger (provider:event_id becomes account/provider/event_id) and reads only the new key, so a redelivered charge already stored under the old key is recorded again and a refund of an earlier charge finds no row.
why_unseen: The finding changed the zero-padding of a review-ledger display id inside a replayed ledger; this is a namespaced idempotency key in a SQLite payment-event table (the violation of rel-2 was a host-based feed-item key with a stored key_version), and the exempt control changes only how an invoice's label is displayed (both files modify earlier versions held in base/) while deduplication and closing use an unchanged stored uid.
